generation_prompt:
You are evaluating a Cine film production skill bundle by performing three bounded user tasks, not reviewing the skill itself. Read the six SKILL.md files and only relevant references in BUNDLE. Do not read other versions, repository config, or prior evaluations. No network, generation, live Bot calls, or edits except your output. Work independently. For each task provide a concrete Chinese response, ordered tool/command plan, small sample artifacts where requested, status and blockers. Do not pretend to execute unavailable tools. Save your responses as Markdown using apply_patch to OUTPUT. Keep combined output <=1800 Chinese characters plus sample JSON.
Cases:
1. 用户：把已经拉片的30秒改编成科幻救援短片，保留原片的节奏，不保留人设。证据：S001 [0,8) 已看图片的观察是“穿黑白服装的女子望向门口”，镜头运动/对白未核验；S002 [8,20) 只有保存的本地路径，没有图片回执；S003 [20,30) 已看图片的观察是“女子在屋顶，旁边有猫和纸形物体”，老六身份未确认。目标单集30秒，改编允许原创。请给4个改编节拍、原片到新分镜映射示例和下一步。
2. 用户：outline、cast、art、script、storyboard都各自validate通过。准备同步画布。outline今天已把C02合并到C01，但cast/script/storyboard是昨天的版本；没有记录各文件hash或版本。用户没有授权花费生成额度；V3平台在线，Agent只做质检。请给实际交接检查和工具调用计划，不能修改现有画布。
3. 用户：这是慢节奏独立短片，不是爽剧，要一个12秒不切的停顿镜头，没有台词。最终用Seedance，不是H3。剧本和场景参考图已准备好，参考图只有本地路径没有上传asset_id，未授权生成。请给可用的分镜/导出方案，说明现有脚本能验证什么、不能验证什么。

arms.B2: same plus scoped blocking and provider-neutral draft guidance

execution: Separate fresh subagents, inherited model/reasoning without overrides, same three prompts. No production Cine session or media generation.
round1_judge_prompt: Blind paired evaluation: Read ONLY U:/AI/MultiAgent/omnigent/.codex-tmp/cine-workflow-ab/candidate-x.md and candidate-y.md. They answer the same 3 user requests: (1) 30s source-inspired sci-fi rescue, incomplete still evidence, original adaptation authorized, need 4 beats + mapping; (2) yesterday's cast/script/storyboard after today's outline C02->C01 merge, all files individually validate, no hashes, V3 Agent QA only, no canvas mutation or generation authorized; (3) independent slow film 12s uncut silent shot, Seedance not H3, local image path not asset ID, no generation authorization. Evaluate actual usefulness, intent preservation, unsupported claims, evidence honesty, upstream freshness, safe Cine/V3 routing, provider boundaries. Do not reward longer text or new tools simply for existing; note integration mistakes and unnecessary blocking. Per case choose X/Y/tie, short reason with quote. Then overall X/Y/tie and limitations (3 planning cases, no real images/generated film). No numeric quality percentage, no network, no skill versions or other repo reads. You may write ONLY OUTPUT with your short review using apply_patch.
round1_caveat: The compressed judge prompt incorrectly described no-dialogue as silent; it also omitted the verified generic V3 endpoint permission limitation. Preserve these reviews, but do not treat them as clean final evidence. All three preferred A; actionable feedback was scoped-blocking and useful neutral drafts.

Evaluation context (same for both): actual current generic seedance_agent_message has no enforced read-only QA mode; generation_allowed=false is not a ban on canvas edits. read_canvas is read-only. The existing novel storyboard exporter is H3-specific, configurable duration but H3-specific checks. A separate handoff.py checker exists, checks file hashes/dependency pins/mapping only, not native schemas/actual image understanding/provider compatibility; it has --source-project read-only adapter. Do not reward the mere mention of this helper. No missing capability should block authorized independent creative drafts. User says no dialogue, NOT complete silence. Background ambience is allowed, not mandatory.
Assess usefulness, creative intent, source-fact honesty, stale upstream handling, safe tool plan, avoiding unnecessary blockage. Cite concrete output strengths/weaknesses. Per case choose X/Y/tie, then overall X/Y/tie. No quality percentages. If both are good say tie; do not prefer complexity or verbosity. Three cases are planning only, not real film quality. No other repo/network reads. Save <=500 words to OUTPUT using apply_patch.
limitations: One generation per arm on three designed edge scenarios, not a randomized/repeated film-production benchmark.
Round 2 reuses original A output and revisits the same cases after feedback: development-set comparison, not held-out generalization.
Same inherited model was requested; provider-side effective model ID was not separately audited.
No measured image understanding or cinematic output quality.
New helper is skill-invoked, not an automatic server-side dispatch gate.
